;; Formalization Plan for Item lf-2966-004
;; Logic: First-Order Logic (FOL) with Quantifiers
;; Goal: Satisfiability (Check if the described scenario is logically possible)

(set-logic FOL)

;; --- 1. VARIABLES (Domains) ---
;; Individuals in the universe
(declare-sort Person 0)

;; --- 2. PREDICATES ---
;; S(x): x is a student
(declare-fun S (Person) Bool)
;; A(x): x is an athlete
(declare-fun A (Person) Bool)
;; N: A constant representing Nia
(declare-const Nia Person)

;; --- 3. ASSERTIONS (The Premises) ---
;; Premise 1: "Some student is an athlete" 
;; Formalization: ∃x (S(x) ∧ A(x))
(assert (exists ((x Person)) (and (S x) (A x))))

;; Premise 2: "Nia being a student does not force Nia to be [an athlete]"
;; Interpretation: This describes a lack of logical implication. 
;; In SMT, we model the existence of a state where Nia is a student but NOT an athlete.
;; Formalization: S(Nia) ∧ ¬A(Nia)
(assert (and (S Nia) (not (A Nia))))

;; --- 4. QUERY ---
;; The problem asks to validate the consistency of these two conditions.
;; We check if there exists a model where both premises hold.
(check-sat)

;; --- 5. EXPECTED SOLVER
